purpose: Measure shared physical prerequisites after the retained five-pilot failures; no scored architecture evaluation
source_identity: Exact Runtime and Calibration Tools sources plus pinned Panda files are recorded and bundled by the driver before any probe; those sources remain fixed until official queue completion
decision_rules: Inspect every declared predicate and actual-host timing separately after official succeeded/exit0 receipt
Physical predicate failures are retained outcomes even if the parent queue job exits normally
A static sensor measurement pass means collection completed; visibility/error findings still govern readiness
A single successful held recovery does not establish broad calibration envelopes or all-seed admissibility
New attempts use fresh IDs/directories; no overwrite or threshold loosening after failure
